Bank of England reduces Bank Rate to 4.75%

20 August 2026

At its meeting ending on 20 August 2026, the Committee voted by a majority of 7 to 2 to reduce Bank Rate by 0.25 percentage points to 4.75%.

The Committee continues to judge that monetary policy will need to remain restrictive for sufficiently long to return inflation sustainably to the 2% target in the medium term.

The Committee will continue to monitor the impact of its policy on inflation. The Committee's approach will be data-dependent.
